FINAL HUMAN REVIEW

KDP handoff

This creates a checklist and summary you can use while signing in to your own KDP account. It does not upload or publish anything.

  1. Compare metadata against your final manuscript and cover.
  2. Review KDP’s current content, rights, AI, print, and pricing rules in your account.
  3. Upload the final interior and cover yourself, then inspect the KDP Previewer.
  4. Verify the sales page and proof copy before release.
